HOFA SYSTEM is a modular environment for custom effect chains, routing, and modulation. We previously covered its free DigiDestroy bitcrusher, which works inside SYSTEM or separately. The new loader supports VST2, VST3, and AU plugins, [...] View post: HOFA SYSTEM can now host one third-party plugin for FREE
